text: 外交部发言人毛宁主持例行记者会。彭博社记者提问，第一个问题，据本社报道，英伟达的芯片目前出现在上海的数据中心，请问外交部对此有何评论？第二个问题是，美国议员和商务部正在推动通过芯片法案来阻止中国公司通过国外渠道来获取美国算力，请问中国是否认为这些限制措施违反了中美的贸易休战协议？鉴于APEC峰会即将召开，中方对作何回应？
text_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning hosted a regular press conference. A Bloomberg reporter asked: First, according to our agency's report, Nvidia chips are currently appearing in data centers in Shanghai; what is the Foreign Ministry's comment? Second, US lawmakers and the Commerce Department are pushing to pass a chip act to prevent Chinese companies from obtaining US computing power through foreign channels; does China believe these restrictive measures violate the China-US trade truce? Given the upcoming APEC summit, how will China respond?
